title: Publish official MCP Registry metadata
notes: This checkout already carried a prior, incomplete pass at MCP Registry metadata (commit f0ac76de 'feat(distribution): add MCP Registry source metadata', landed before MBR-903/MBR-906 in this branch's history, not using the MBR-907 commit-message convention or writing task evidence): server.json (name/npm/publication/nativeArtifacts/signatureRequirements), scripts/release/verify-mcp-registry.mjs, and tests/mcp-registry/registry.test.mjs. Per this task's hard rules, scripts/release/verify-mcp-registry.mjs is outside this task's allowlist (only the new scripts/release/registry/** subdirectory is writable) and was left unmodified; this task's own new verifier (scripts/release/registry/verify-server-json.mjs) imports and delegates to it read-only rather than duplicating its identity/publication logic. server.json and tests/mcp-registry/registry.test.mjs are both in this task's allowlist; server.json gained one new field (`tools`, additive) and registry.test.mjs was left unmodified (all 4 of its pre-existing tests still pass unchanged -- see commands.log).

Verified server.json's pre-existing content against MBR-906 reality before extending it: server.name/server.npm.mcpName ('io.github.orthic-labs/membrane') and server.npm.package ('@orthic/membrane') already matched npm/package.json's mcpName and name fields; server.version ('0.0.0-source') already matched npm/package.json's version; server.nativeArtifacts already named all six of MBR-906's real npm/platforms/**/package.json packages (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm64, linux-x64, win32-arm64, win32-x64), each with sha256/signature/platformReceipt honestly null (no signed native artifact exists yet). No identity, version, package name, or URL was invented or changed by this task.

This task's own contribution is the reserved namespace's tool-contract-coverage claim: server.json's new `tools` array, generated from and mechanically verified against the two REAL live source modules -- `TOOLS` in mcp/server.mjs (the exact tool list the running MCP server advertises) and `OPERATIONS` in engine/crates/membrane-protocol/bindings/operations.mjs (the cross-operation registry with schemaVersion/errorVersion/golden-fixture/error-taxonomy coverage) -- via the new scripts/release/registry/tool-contract-coverage.mjs. Neither module was modified; both were imported read-only.

The owner-flagged gap was investigated directly against the real source, not assumed: mcp/server.mjs exposes 10 real MCP tools (membrane_context, membrane_source_read, membrane_cortex, membrane_knowledge_propose, membrane_checkpoint_save, membrane_checkpoint_load, membrane_working_context, membrane_temporal_fact, membrane_scratchpad, membrane_feedback). engine/crates/membrane-protocol/bindings/operations.mjs's OPERATIONS registry has entries for 9 of those 10 plus two internal hub.* operations that are not MCP tools at all -- membrane_cortex has no OPERATIONS entry: no schemaVersion/errorVersion pair, no golden success/error fixtures under operations/operations/, no closed error-code taxonomy validated by validateOperationFixtures(). Confirmed this is exactly the gap the task brief named (MBR-401, commit 82ff2f7f, added membrane_cortex as a live tool but did not add its OPERATIONS entry, despite MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md's MBR-401 override note naming engine/crates/membrane-protocol/** and operations/operations/** as owning 'the canonical operation registry ... required by the five Cortex operations').

Handling of the gap: server.json's tools array marks membrane_cortex `"contractCoverage": "gap"` with a non-empty, specific `gapReason`, and marks the other nine `"contractCoverage": "operations_registry"` with no gapReason. This task does NOT add golden fixtures or an error taxonomy for membrane_cortex (that is membrane_cortex's own OPERATIONS-registry work, requiring engine/crates/membrane-protocol/** and operations/operations/** changes, both outside this task's allowlist) -- it makes the registry metadata report the true, current coverage state instead of silently presenting membrane_cortex as equivalent to the other nine contract-covered tools. scripts/release/registry/verify-server-json.mjs enforces this mechanically: it recomputes the expected tool-coverage list live from the two real modules and rejects server.json if the declared list differs in membership, ordering, contractCoverage value, or gapReason presence -- including the specific case (tested directly) of someone marking membrane_cortex "operations_registry" without adding real fixtures, so this cannot silently drift back to overstating coverage in a future change.

scripts/release/registry/verify-server-json.mjs composes rather than duplicates: it delegates identity/publication/native-artifact verification verbatim to the existing (unmodified) verifyMcpRegistry from scripts/release/verify-mcp-registry.mjs, and adds only the new tool-contract-coverage check. Run against this real, unpublished checkout with requirePublished (default) true, it fails closed on 'registry namespace or native artifacts are unpublished' -- the honest, current pre-release state (no MCP Registry namespace reservation, no npm publish, no signed native artifact exist). Run with requirePublished:false, both the identity checks and the new tool-coverage check pass against the real repo, proving the metadata itself (as opposed to publication state) is internally consistent and drift-free today.

tests/mcp-registry/tool-contract-coverage.test.mjs (4 tests) proves computeToolContractCoverage() against both the real TOOLS/OPERATIONS modules (asserting membrane_cortex is the one gap, with the other nine covered and no gapReason) and a synthetic before/after registry (proving the general mechanism, not just today's specific tool set). tests/mcp-registry/verify-server-json.test.mjs (9 tests) proves the real server.json's tools field matches the live derivation exactly; that the unpublished checkout still fails closed even though tool coverage is correct (publication state and metadata correctness are checked independently); that requirePublished:false accepts the real repo; and, via mutated fixtures, that a missing tools array, an understated tool count, silently upgrading membrane_cortex to operations_registry, a gap entry missing its gapReason, a covered tool carrying a stray gapReason, and an invented tool name are all rejected.

No cargo, pnpm, Tauri, right-release, npm publish, codesign, notarytool, stapler, spctl, signtool, or AzureSignTool command was run. No mutating git command (add/commit/checkout/stash/reset/rebase/push) was run. No MCP Registry submission, namespace reservation, or signing occurred -- publication remains Adrian's decision. Only `node --test tests/mcp-registry/*.test.mjs` (17/17 pass) and the two new verifier/generator scripts (run directly for demonstration, not as a publish step) were executed -- see commands.log. No .github/workflows/**, CI, or hosted/self-hosted runner configuration was added.

docs/install-registry.md is new (this task's allowlist explicitly names it as a new file) and documents what server.json asserts, how each part is mechanically checked, the tool-contract-coverage mechanism, the membrane_cortex gap in full, and what this task deliberately did not do.
